resources.method: Full Poisson with exact (1,1) sector replacement

analytic_sector.sector: bra=1, ket=1 only; higher sectors omitted
analytic_sector.approximation: Second order in hopping. Not the full untruncated Poisson estimator; no QM input.

resources.sampling_reuse: Reuses the parent samples for all higher sectors; not an independent random run

interpretation: The second-order-only curve is biased/truncated and cannot be reported as full Poisson accuracy.
